card.fires_on: The letter p (or capital P) that starts a word split into pieces, most often the start of paresthesia/paresis in nerve-symptom lists. It also fires on p after a hyphen or space in other split words such as eye-popping or diamond panners.

modes.label: Paresthesia and paresis
modes.description: The p that begins paresthesia or paresis in lists of nerve side effects.

modes.label: Other split words starting with p
modes.description: A lone p or P starting a rare word or name that is split into pieces, such as a name or a hyphenated compound.

card.writes: It promotes forms of pour and suppresses -our endings, so it pushes toward a word beginning with the letters p-o-u-r.
card.plain: It marks a lone letter p at the start of a split word, especially paresthesia in lists of nerve symptoms.
